title: SEO/GEO Program Lead (Senior)
description:
About the job

𝗦𝗘𝗢 & 𝗚𝗘𝗢 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 (𝗦𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗼𝗿) - Salud Digital • Remoto • LATAM/México




𝗞𝗮𝘃𝗿𝗲𝗻 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗲𝘀 • Contratista independiente • Tiempo completo




𝗤𝘂𝗶é𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗼𝘀

Una empresa estadounidense de tecnologia en salud. Operamos una plataforma de telesalud nacional y una clinica de atencion primaria en Miami. Hoy, ninguna de las dos aparece en las busquedas de Google que importan. Una tiene autoridad de dominio 2. La otra tiene 9.




No estamos buscando a alguien que "haga SEO". Buscamos a la persona que va a construir el programa completo desde cero y ser dueña del resultado.




⭐ 𝗤𝘂é 𝘃𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗿 

• Ser dueño del programa de busqueda de dos marcas: una nacional de telesalud, una local de atencion medica en Miami

• Mapear palabras clave a paginas y definir la arquitectura de URLs de ambos sitios

• Escribir los briefs que guian al equipo de contenido — tu decides que se escribe y por que

• Traducir requerimientos de busqueda en tickets tecnicos: hreflang para el split espanol/ingles, schema, canonicals, una URL indexable por servicio

• Dirigir la estrategia de GEO: optimizacion para ChatGPT, Gemini y Google AI Overviews. Bloques de preguntas y respuestas, consistencia de entidad, datos estructurados

• Cargar y mantener el seguimiento de posiciones. Reportar movimiento mensual con numeros

• Dirigir el programa de adquisicion de enlaces hacia una meta definida de dominios de referencia




𝗤𝘂é 𝗻𝗲𝗰𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘀

✓ 5+ años en SEO, con al menos un programa que hayas construido desde cero y llevado a resultados medibles. Vamos a pedirte los numeros

✓ Experiencia con SEO local (Google Business Profile, citaciones, reseñas) y con SEO nacional de intención comercial. Necesitamos las dos

✓ Manejo de Semrush o Ahrefs a nivel profesional

✓ Entender la diferencia entre optimizar para Google y optimizar para motores de respuesta con IA — y poder explicarla

✓ Español nativo. Inglés a nivel de lectura técnica mínimo

✓ Disponibilidad durante horario laboral del Este de EE. UU. para videollamadas.




✅ 𝗦𝘂𝗺𝗮 𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵𝗼

→ Experiencia en salud, farmaceutica o industrias reguladas

→ Experiencia con contenido en espanol para el mercado hispano de EE. UU.

→ Haber trabajado con equipos de desarrollo, no solo con agencias




🤝 𝗤𝘂é 𝗼𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗼𝘀

✓ MEXICO: USD $2,800 - 3,200 mensuales, pagados contra factura

✓ Tarifa en el rango mas alto del mercado regional. Pagamos bien y esperamos el resultado

✓ Propiedad real: eres la primera contratacion de este programa, no la quinta. Las decisiones son tuyas

✓ Una metrica clara y datos limpios para trabajar. Ya tenemos la investigacion hecha — 56 palabras clave priorizadas, analisis competitivo y linea base de visibilidad en IA para ambas marcas




🎯 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝗮𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗿

Mándanos dos cosas. En corto — no queremos una carta de presentación.

𝟭. 𝗘𝗻 𝗺á𝘅𝗶𝗺𝗼 𝘂𝗻𝗮 𝗽á𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗮: un dominio para el que construiste un programa de SEO, donde estaba cuando llegaste, donde quedo, y en cuanto tiempo. Con numeros.

𝟮. 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗽𝘂é𝘀 𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗼𝘀 𝗲𝗻 𝘂𝗻 𝗽á𝗿𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗼 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗼 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝗿𝗱𝗮𝗿í𝗮𝘀 𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼: una clínica en Miami con autoridad 9 que hoy aparece en búsquedas de clinicas en Colorado y en Nigeria por confusión de marca.




𝙇𝙖𝙨 𝙥𝙤𝙨𝙩𝙪𝙡𝙖𝙘𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙚𝙨 𝙨𝙞𝙣 𝙣ú𝙢𝙚𝙧𝙤𝙨 𝙘𝙤𝙣𝙘𝙧𝙚𝙩𝙤𝙨 𝙣𝙤 𝙨𝙚𝙧á𝙣 𝙧𝙚𝙫𝙞𝙨𝙖𝙙𝙖𝙨.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
About the job

At Experis, the ManpowerGroup division specializing in IT projects, solutions, and professional technology talent, we connect top tech professionals with strategic initiatives across international markets, driving innovation and career growth through a people-centered approach.




🚀 We’re hiring: Paid Media Specialist 🚀

📍 CDMX | Hybrid | 

Are you a performance-driven Paid Media professional who knows Google Ads inside and out?

We’re looking for a Paid Media Specialist to join a global Marketing team within a B2B SaaS / technology environment. This is a highly hands-on role with real ownership of paid media execution, optimization, testing, and performance.

🎯 What you’ll own

• Manage, build, and optimize paid search and paid social campaigns

• Own Google Ads strategy, campaign structure, bidding, keywords, audiences, and budgets

• Manage and optimize significant paid media investment

• Monitor daily performance and identify optimization opportunities

• Build campaigns from scratch and run structured A/B tests

• Optimize landing pages, conversion paths, and post-click experiences

• Connect paid media performance to the full funnel: MQLs → SQLs → opportunities → pipeline → revenue

• Develop weekly/monthly performance reporting and actionable insights

• Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Web, Content, and Revenue Operations teams




🔎 What we’re looking for




✅ Strong, hands-on expertise in Google Ads — this is a key requirement

✅ Proven experience managing campaigns and budgets end-to-end

✅ Experience managing significant paid media budgets

✅ B2B SaaS / Technology Marketing experience

✅ Demand Generation / Lead Generation experience

✅ Experience across Paid Search and Paid Social

✅ Strong analytical and performance optimization skills

✅ Experience with landing page optimization and conversion rate improvement

✅ Ability to translate data into business and revenue insights

✅ Advanced English — you’ll work in an international environment

✅ Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field

⭐ A strong plus:

🇨🇦 Previous experience working with Canadian markets or legal authorization to work in Canada.

💡 Who will thrive in this role?

Someone who is genuinely hands-on and can take ownership of campaigns rather than simply coordinate them.

If you can walk us through a Google Ads campaign you built from scratch, explain the budget you managed, the metrics you owned, the optimizations you made, and how those decisions impacted business results — we want to hear from you.

📍 Location: Mexico City

🏢 Work model: Hybrid

🌎 Environment: International

🗣️ English: Advanced

📩 Interested? Apply directly or send me your CV via DM.

description:
About the job

Marketing Operations Specialist

Full Time | Remote or Hybrid (Aguascalientes, MX)

Innovate with Benchmark Digital as a Marketing Operations Specialist

Everyone wants to make the world a better place. We work to make it happen. By joining Benchmark Gensuite and exploring careers in the EHS, Sustainability, and ESG Disclosure Reporting space, you’ll be helping customers throughout the business community empower informed decision-making, improve employee safety, and lessen their environmental footprint while creating a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. Join us and help make the corporate world better for the planet and better for its employees. Benchmark Gensuite jobs play a crucial role in helping develop our unified EHS, Sustainability, and ESG digital transformation software solutions that enable cross-functional performance excellence, enhance businesses’ sustainability efforts, and help them achieve their ESG goals. With our incredible global team, the collaborative spirit of our subscribers and partners, and the continuous innovation in exciting new technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and IoT, a career at Benchmark Gensuite means you will continuously use and evolve your skills to develop fresh ideas and initiatives.

Benchmark Gensuite Benefits

At Benchmark Gensuite, your hard work is rewarded. We offer annual bonus programs, regular team-building events, and off-cycle reviews to promptly give excellent performers their due. With engaging team activities including happy hours and exciting virtual events, we actively encourage our teams to connect and build a strong, supportive, and fun rapport! Our Benchmark Gensuite Team Member Networks, like the Respect for Diversity Group and the Sustainability Group, offer a safe and supportive space, bringing together team members who share a common identity and empowering them to voice their ideas and initiate action. Explore Benchmark Gensuite job openings and come join us as we combine our collective creativity and passion to meet and exceed the expectations of our customers.

About The Role

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Specialist to join our Marketing & Business Development team, reporting to the Associate Director, Marketing & Growth Automation. This hands-on role will support the day-to-day execution and reliability of our marketing automation engine—from translating campaign briefs into emails, forms, landing pages, calls-to-action, workflows, and audience segments to maintaining clean data and actionable reporting. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable systems, improving messy processes, and growing into broader marketing operations ownership.

What You'll Do

Campaign & Workflow Automation


Build, launch, monitor, and optimize HubSpot campaigns, workflows, nurture programs, segmentation, and tracking.
Maintain campaign organization, naming conventions, templates, and subscription types.
Support customer marketing programs, including newsletters, onboarding, renewals, win-back, surveys, adoption, and events.
Monitor email deliverability and compliance, escalating technical issues as needed.


AI-Assisted Campaign Creation


Use approved AI tools to accelerate drafting, personalization, testing, and campaign production.
Apply human review for accuracy, brand alignment, data use, and quality.
Identify responsible opportunities to automate campaign work with appropriate controls.


Reporting & Analytics


Build HubSpot dashboards for campaign, funnel, pipeline, attribution, and ROI performance.
Deliver regular reporting, identify trends and anomalies, and maintain UTM/tracking standards.


Systems & Data Hygiene


Maintain HubSpot data quality, properties, segmentation, account hierarchies, and database organization.
Monitor integrations across HubSpot, CRM, ZoomInfo, Zapier, Chili Piper, and AI tools; troubleshoot and coordinate issue resolution.
Document processes, standardize fields, and manage HubSpot access and permissions.


Growth Experimentation


Build, QA, and document A/B tests across emails, landing pages, and forms.
Track learnings and support conversion rate optimization across the funnel.


HubSpot Requirements


Specialist-level HubSpot Marketing Hub proficiency, including workflows, segmentation, data management, troubleshooting, and reporting.
HubSpot Marketing Hub Software Certification preferred at hire and required within 90 days. Additional HubSpot certifications are a plus.


Required Experience & Qualifications


3+ years of hands-on experience using HubSpot, preferably HubSpot Marketing Hub in a B2B SaaS, technology, or similarly complex B2B environment 
Demonstrated experience independently building, managing, testing, and troubleshooting HubSpot workflows and marketing automation 
Strong experience with HubSpot email marketing, campaigns, contact management, lists, segmentation, forms, landing pages, calls-to-action, and reporting 
Experience executing automated email, nurture, lifecycle, customer marketing, product adoption, or event campaigns 
Working knowledge of CRM and marketing database concepts, including contact properties, lifecycle stages, segmentation, data hygiene, lead management, and campaign attribution 
Experience reviewing campaign performance and using data to identify optimization opportunities and explain findings clearly 
Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to perform campaign quality assurance before launch 
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment 


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting customer marketing, customer engagement, product adoption, or lifecycle campaigns 
Proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal (B2-C1).
Experience using AI tools to support campaign development, personalization, analysis, and execution with appropriate human review 
Experience with CRM integrations, marketing data management, ZoomInfo, Chili Piper, Zapier, or similar marketing technology 
Familiarity with lead management and Marketing-to-Sales or Business Development handoffs 
Experience working with distributed or global teams and supporting global or multi-region marketing programs 
Exposure to multi-touch attribution frameworks 
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

description:
About the job

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

Location: Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only - supporting a team in the EST time zone.

About The Role

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.


3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years. 
You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number. 
You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus. 
You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging. 
You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role. 
You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone. 
You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy. 
You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight. 
You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule. 
You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you. 
You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client. 
Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible. 


A day in the life


Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase. 
Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems. 
Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do. 
Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final. 
Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions. 
Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build. 
Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering. 
Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests. 


What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.


Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. 
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain. 
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. 
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. 


Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

This role will own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for key fraud projects. You will work closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, and external vendors to design and launch secure, compliant fraud systems that enable Kraken to operate across jurisdictions while protecting users from fraud and supporting investigations—without disrupting legitimate client activity. description:
About the job

About Amply

Amply is a digital design and development agency partnering with B2B SaaS, healthcare and fintech companies to build brands and digital experiences that drive growth. We take craft seriously, invest in our people, and believe great work comes from great culture.




About the role

We’re looking for a senior web designer who can own projects end to end, from brief and creative direction through design system, execution and developer handoff.




The role has changed a lot in the last year. We’ve always built exceptional Webflow sites, and we still do, but we’re increasingly working as a strategic partner to marketing leaders, and AI is reshaping how sites get designed, built and improved. Our projects are increasingly platform agnostic. The designers who do well here bring strong judgment and taste, use AI fluently as part of their process, and are curious about where this is heading rather than attached to how it used to work.




You’ll work across both project-based engagements and long-term client accounts, alongside design leads, project managers and our development team. It suits someone who enjoys ownership, thinks about the business goal behind every brief, and holds themselves to a high standard.




What you’ll do

Own web design on your projects from kickoff to launch: concept and direction, design system, execution, developer handoff and design QA on the build
Deliver production-ready work at a consistently high standard, with clean design systems, consistent typography and files a development team can build from
Interpret briefs critically, define the right level of complexity for each client, and develop original directions from research and references
Manage scope and time on your work, and flag early when either is at risk
Present to clients and defend design decisions with clear reasoning
Collaborate with developers on feasibility and review builds against your designs before launch
Use AI tools throughout the process, from research and discovery synthesis to reference gathering, concept exploration and early copy
Contribute to our design system, standards and knowledge sharing across the team




Who we’re looking for

This role isn’t suitable for junior or mid-level candidates. We’re looking for someone who already operates at a senior level and can own a project’s design outcome independently.

5+ years designing marketing websites, with at least 2 in an agency or multi-client environment. The pace and client dynamics are specific
Portfolio of shipped B2B or SaaS websites where you can speak to the brief, the constraints and what you’d do differently
Figma at a systems level: variables, local styles, auto layout, component architecture and naming conventions ready for developer handoff
Working understanding of Webflow, enough to design for it, know its limits and review a build against your file
Demonstrated, current use of AI in a real design workflow. Claude, Flora, Midjourney or equivalents; fluency matters more than the specific tool. This is a requirement, and you’ll be asked to demonstrate it during the process
Confident presenting to clients and comfortable with pushback in both directions
Strong on estimates and timelines, and a proactive communicator when they’re at risk
Excellent English, C1 minimum
Able to work within EST hours
Comfortable working autonomously, with clear direction and support from our Head of Design




Nice to have

Motion literacy: Lottie, Jitter, After Effects, Rive, GSAP-level understanding
Illustration or brand identity work




How we hire

Portfolio review. Send three projects, with a short note on one of them about where AI was used in the process and where it wasn’t.
Conversation with the Head of Design.
Paid working session. A real brief and our tools, where we look at how you move from brief to direction and how AI fits into your process.
Conversation with the founders.




How we work

Fully remote.

We’re a fast-moving agency, so this is a great fit for someone who wants impact beyond their own tasks. Every voice counts on how we work and what we change. We’re also a highly organised company, so if you have a genuine passion for structure you’ll feel at home. We’re not a family, we’re a team working towards the same goal.




Benefits

Quarterly/Yearly Bonus System
15 days PTO plus 9 paid US holidays
$500 per year towards learning and skill development
Sick leave and maternity/paternity leave as needed

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you an aspiring knowledge manager or technical writer with a passion for managing multiple projects and collaborating with SMEs to develop best-in-class content, using cutting-edge knowledge management technologies, including AI? Join a forward-thinking team, where you'll help drive our technology-centric knowledge framework within the Global Support organization, working with peers and subject matter experts to enhance our knowledge assets using the latest in AI and other innovative tech.

You should apply if:



You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. 



Learn More About What We Value At Samsara.

In this role, you will:



Assist in managing the content operations roadmap and contribute to the completion of projects within the roadmap
Collaborate with teams to implement and maintain knowledge development processes and standards
Support various knowledge development projects and initiatives, ensuring their successful execution
Assist in monitoring and reporting on KPIs to evaluate knowledge effectiveness and sharing insights with the organization
Participate in identifying and implementing improvements in knowledge processes and technology



Minimum requirements for this role:



Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience demonstrating expertise in knowledge management, or technical documentation.
6+ years of knowledge management/technical writing/technical content development experience, including creating, capturing, structuring, and maintaining knowledge
Experienced in working with knowledge management and ticketing systems
Experienced in preparing AI-optimized content and building AI models for generating content
Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
Adept at managing multiple priorities and embracing change with ease



An ideal candidate also is:



Proficient in Jira
Experienced in working in Agile/Scrum environments
Experienced in using Confluence, Tableau, and Zendesk or similar CRM tools
Experienced in managing content/knowledge-related projects



Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

The Role

The Product Operations Manager is the connective tissue between product strategy and execution within the Deel Local Payroll team. You'll embed directly within the product team, ensuring the development lifecycle runs smoothly, stakeholders stay aligned, and the voice of the customer drives continuous improvement. You don't define what we build—that's the PM's domain. You empower the entire team to move faster, smarter, and with total clarity. You'll partner with Product Managers, engineering, support, compliance, and operations teams across multiple countries to deliver world-class payroll solutions at scale.

Responsibilities


Backlog governance: Own daily backlog hygiene, ticket triage, and progress reporting. Route support requests correctly and keep Jira workflows flowing.
Product planning and insights: Facilitate planning meetings, consolidate stakeholder feedback, and support prioritization exercises. Build dashboards that turn data into actionable insights.
Customer feedback and discovery: Collect feedback from support tickets, CSAT, product usage data, and customer interviews. Triage, analyze, and route insights to the product team.
Product releases and go-to-market: Create release plans, align stakeholders across geographies, build launch documentation, and ensure post-launch success.
Stakeholder coordination: Manage relationships with support, sales, and compliance teams. Organize retrospectives, maintain feedback channels, and ensure the operational machine runs smoothly.
Cross-country dependency management: Track and surface dependencies between teams and countries, ensuring handovers don't create silos.
Data and operational reporting: Build reports on product KPIs, feature adoption, and business metrics. Work with data teams to maintain dashboards and track performance.
Tools and process optimization: Maintain Jira workflows and dashboards as a system admin. Design automations using Zapier or Parabola to improve team efficiency.


Qualifications


3 to 5 years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, or similar operational roles within SaaS or fintech

Expert-level Jira administration: workflows, automation, ticket hygiene, and dashboards

Process design mindset with ability to identify gaps and build scalable solutions

Experience with OSHD/KTLO operational workflows

About the job

The IT Analyst is a frontline operations role for real time monitoring, incident detection, triage, and operational support across enterprise systems including applications, cloud services, and security. 

IT Analyst will interpret alerts, troubleshoot issues, execute runbooks, escalate when needed, and ensure consistent service availability and performance across the global IT landscape.

This position requires both technical and business application knowledge and requires the ability to communicate and escalate to other IT functions to support issue resolution. 







KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Monitoring and Event Management

Continuously monitor applications and global infrastructure using enterprise monitoring platforms. 
Analyze alerts, logs, and performance indicators to detect system degradation. 
Identify potential incidents early and initiate appropriate triage workflows.




Incident Response & Troubleshooting

Perform first and second level diagnosis and troubleshooting across applications and security components. 
Execute documented runbooks, SOPs, and operational response steps. 
Open and manage service tickets with internal teams and third‑party vendors; perform follow‑ups, document incident details, actions taken and resolutions.




Communication & Coordination 

Act as a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for incidents during assigned shifts, providing transparent, timely communication to operations leadership and technical teams. 
Collaborate with network, server, application, and security teams to expedite issue resolution. 
Support shift handoffs with clear documentation and verbal/written briefings. Continues Improvement & Support
Participate in system checks, patch validation, performance validation, and routine service reviews.
Contribute insights to reduce recurring incidents and improve processes. 
Recommend improvements to monitoring thresholds, automation opportunities, and runbook updates. 
Assist in analysis and improvements when resolving technical issues within broader IT areas.




SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE:

At least 2 years working on:

Experience providing support in SAP environments and other SAP troubleshooting tools. 
Foundational understanding of operating systems, cloud concepts, and enterprise applications.
Knowledge of SuccesFactors, SAP BW, Vertex is a Plus
Strong problem-solving, issue interpretation, and troubleshooting skills.
Effective English communication (Written and Oral) and interpersonal skills

description:
About the job

Site: Las Fuentes, Tlaquepaque, Jalisco.

Modalidad de trabajo: Hibrido




RESÚMEN DE LAS RESPONSABILIDADES DE LA POSICIÓN:

Responsable de administrar, coordinar y controlar las operaciones de importación de productos terminados, materiales promocionales y otros bienes requeridos por Herbalife México, asegurando el cumplimiento de las regulaciones aduaneras, sanitarias y fiscales aplicables.

La posición actúa como enlace estratégico entre las plantas de manufactura Herbalife, de manufactura externa, agentes aduanales, operadores logísticos, autoridades regulatorias y áreas internas de la compañía, garantizando la continuidad del abastecimiento de producto para el mercado mexicano, la mitigación de riesgos operativos y regulatorios, y la optimización de los procesos de comercio exterior.




DESCRIPCIÓN DETALLADA DE LAS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Administrar y coordinar las operaciones de importación para asegurar el abastecimiento oportuno de productos al mercado mexicano y el cumplimiento de los planes de inventario y servicio.

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de las regulaciones y requisitos establecidos por Aduanas, COFEPRIS, SAGARPA, SAT, Secretaría de Economía y demás autoridades aplicables a las operaciones de comercio exterior.

• Coordinar con plantas de manufactura Herbalife, y manufactura externa, agentes aduanales y proveedores logísticos la ejecución eficiente de embarques internacionales desde origen hasta su liberación en México.

• Gestionar y validar la documentación requerida para las operaciones de importación, incluyendo permisos sanitarios, certificados de origen, certificados de libre venta y demás requisitos regulatorios y aduaneros.

• Monitorear el estatus de embarques, identificar riesgos potenciales en la cadena de suministro y desarrollar acciones preventivas y correctivas para minimizar impactos en la disponibilidad de producto.

• Liderar iniciativas de mejora continua mediante el análisis de costos de importación, tiempos de tránsito, gastos aduanales, almacenajes e indicadores operativos, identificando e implementando oportunidades para optimizar procesos, reducir riesgos y fortalecer el cumplimiento regulatorio.

• Elaborar reportes y archivos digitales, para una correcta administración de las importaciones y control de pagos.

• Participar en auditorías internas y externas, asegurando el cumplimiento de políticas corporativas, controles internos y regulaciones aplicables al comercio exterior.

• Experto en procesos de importación y comercio exterior de Herbalife México, evaluando riesgos regulatorios y colaborando con las áreas de Planeación, Compras, Calidad, Asuntos Regulatorios, Finanzas, Distribución y Supply Chain para garantizar la continuidad operativa y el cumplimiento normativo.




RESPONSABILIDADES DE SUPERVISIÓN:

No cuenta con personal a cargo de forma directa.

Puede coordinar funcionalmente actividades con agentes aduanales, proveedores logísticos y equipos multifuncionales involucrados en la cadena de suministro internacional.




PERFIL DEL PUESTO:

Habilidades y Competencias:




Competencias:

• Conocimiento especializado en Comercio Exterior y Aduanas.

• Planeación y coordinación de operaciones complejas.

• Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de evaluación de riesgos.

• Toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Gestión de proyectos.

• Influencia y colaboración multifuncional.

• Resolución de problemas complejos.

• Comunicación efectiva con partes interesadas nacionales e internacionales.

• Orientación a resultados.

• Mejora continua y optimización de procesos.

• Adaptabilidad y manejo del cambio.

• Alto nivel de integridad y ética profesional.




Conocimientos:

• Regulaciones de COFEPRIS: Conocimiento de los requisitos de COFEPRIS para la importación de suplementos alimenticios, incluyendo el Permiso Sanitario Previo de Importación (PSPI), la autorización sanitaria y el etiquetado específico

• Regulaciones de SAGARPA: Familiaridad con los requisitos de SAGARPA para la importación de productos alimenticios, incluyendo certificaciones de sanidad animal y análisis específicos para productos que contienen ingredientes de origen animal

• Regulaciones de la FDA: Entendimiento de las normativas de la FDA para la exportación de suplementos alimenticios, incluyendo la certificación de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP), el Certificado de Libre Venta y el etiquetado y declaraciones nutricionales

• Legislación aduanera y fiscal aplicable a importaciones en México.

• Reglas generales de comercio exterior.

• Clasificación arancelaria y regulaciones no arancelarias.

• Procesos de importación marítima, aérea y terrestre.

• Tratados comerciales y certificados de origen.

• Gestión de proveedores logísticos y agentes aduanales.

• Herramientas de análisis de datos y generación de reportes.




Idiomas:

• Inglés avanzado (oral y escrito).




Experiencia:

• 3 o más años de experiencia en importaciones, comercio exterior, logística internacional o cumplimiento aduanero.

• Experiencia comprobable en industrias reguladas, preferentemente suplementos alimenticios, alimentos, farmacéutica o bienes de consumo.

• Experiencia en interacción con autoridades regulatorias y agentes aduanales.

• Experiencia liderando proyectos de mejora y optimización de procesos.




Educación:

• Licenciatura en Negocios Internacionales, Comercio Exterior, Relaciones Internacionales, Logística, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Deseable certificación o especialización en Comercio Exterior, Aduanas o Supply Chain.

Hi! We're Yalo

We're on a mission to revolutionize how businesses sell with intelligent AI agents. Born in Latin America and driven by its spirit of innovation, we're now transforming how enterprises around the globe engage their customers and grow.

We're entering our Agentic Era: we no longer just deploy conversational commerce — we put AI agents inside some of the world's largest enterprises, working alongside their commercial teams. Someone has to own whether those agents actually change the business.

That is this role.

The mission

Turn strategic customer relationships into measurable business impact and sustainable growth — operating at the intersection of strategy, consulting, customer success, commercial growth and AI.

This is not a traditional CSM role. No ticket queues. No adoption calls for the sake of adoption. You walk into an ambiguous business problem, structure it, use data to understand it, build the recommendation, prototype the AI solution, align senior stakeholders — and turn it into production and measurable results.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

Sobre CUBBO




Somos CUBBO, una empresa respaldada por venture capital que construye la infraestructura del ecommerce; combinando tecnología y logística para que las marcas escalen el comercio moderno.

Apoyamos a las marcas conectando todo su proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología y operaciones.




Nuestra plataforma atiende a cientos de marcas y procesa +1M de pedidos mensuales, entregando con velocidad y consistencia.




Trabajamos desde la Ciudad de México, donde nuestro equipo construye herramientas y capacidades logísticas para el comercio moderno.




Nuestra Visión




Empoderar a las marcas para que ganen libertad, convirtiéndonos en la plataforma presente en cada transacción del comercio moderno.

No estamos aquí solo para competir; estamos aquí para dominar y redefinir el futuro del comercio moderno. Si eres un jugador AAA, CUBBO te ofrece una plataforma sin igual para ser parte de esta transformación.




Nuestra Misión




Ayudamos al comercio moderno a reducir fricción y entregar mejores experiencias de compra. Nuestra plataforma conecta todo el proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología, operaciones y logística.




Ubicación




Ciudad de México (Headquarters)

Modelo híbrido: 4 días presencial, 1 día remoto

Sí, no somos 100% remotos.




El Rol




En Cubbo operamos varias líneas de negocio con objetivos y necesidades propias a nivel de comunicación y marketing.

Como Product Marketing Manager, serás la persona que asuma la responsabilidad de una vertical y la comprenda a fondo —producto, cliente, motivos de compra y de rechazo— para traducir ese conocimiento en demanda: posicionar a Cubbo en su mercado, dotar al equipo comercial de argumentos sólidos y asegurar que las prioridades de marketing respondan a los objetivos del negocio.




Responsabilidades Clave




Mercado, Posicionamiento y Mensaje:

• Ser el experto en tu vertical: quién compra, por qué compra, qué lo detiene y contra qué nos comparan.

• Definir y mantener vivos el ICP, las buyer personas y los casos de uso prioritarios.

• Construir el posicionamiento, la propuesta de valor y el messaging de la vertical, y asegurar que se use igual en web, campañas, ventas y contenido.

• Levantar inteligencia competitiva y de mercado de forma continua, no como un ejercicio anual.

• Pasar tiempo real con clientes y con el equipo comercial: llamadas, deals perdidos, onboarding, visitas a almacén.




Go-to-Market y Ejecución:

• Diseñar y ejecutar el plan de marketing de tu vertical, alineado al objetivo de revenue del trimestre.

• Operar las campañas de paid de tu BU: definir audiencia, oferta y mensaje, y revisar performance con la agencia.

• Producir contenido comercial de tu vertical y alimentar el calendario editorial central con ángulos, ideas y piezas.

• Entregar los insumos de SEO y PR de tu BU: keywords comerciales, objeciones reales, historias que valgan la pena contarse.

• Liderar los lanzamientos: qué se anuncia, a quién, con qué narrativa y con qué material de soporte.

• Escribir los briefs de landing pages, campañas y piezas que ejecute el equipo central o las agencias.




Ventas, Pipeline y Negocio:

• Ser el socio de Marketing del líder comercial de tu vertical: traducir el número en un plan de generación de demanda.

• Construir el material que Ventas necesita: decks, one-pagers, battlecards, respuestas a objeciones, casos de éxito.

• Analizar el embudo de tu BU: de dónde vienen los leads, dónde se caen, qué mensajes convierten y cuáles no.

• Traer de vuelta al equipo de Marketing lo que aprendes en el campo, para que el sistema mejore y no solo tu vertical.

• Priorizar: decidir qué hace Marketing por tu BU este trimestre y defender esa decisión con datos.




Habilidades y Competencias




• Mentalidad de Ownership, tomando total responsabilidad por el éxito o fracaso de un lanzamiento.

• Agilidad para adaptarse a un entorno de startup que procesa millones de órdenes y cambia constantemente.

• Pensamiento estratégico equilibrado con una ejecución impecable en los detalles.




Hard Skills




• 1 a 4 años en Product Marketing, Growth, Marketing B2B, marketing comercial o estrategia.

• Estructurar y comunicar ideas efectivamente para landing pages, contenido comercial, material de ventas.

• Manejo práctico de campañas de paid (Google, Meta, LinkedIn): saber leer el performance y decidir qué cambiar.

• Uso fluido de IA para producir texto, diseño, investigación, análisis. No es un plus, es parte del trabajo.

• Cómodo con datos y CRM (HubSpot o similar): leer el embudo, entender de dónde viene el pipeline y crear estrategias para mejorar.




Deseable




• Experiencia previa en el sector de ecommerce, logística tecnológica o fintech.

• Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de Shopify, VTEX o plataformas similares.

• Experiencia trabajando en startups de alto crecimiento con rondas de inversión Serie A en adelante.

• Experiencia previa trabajando con agencias de paid, SEO o PR.




Nuestros Valores




Customer First: En CUBBO, el cliente es nuestra estrella norte. Operamos bajo el principio de que la mejor decisión para nuestros clientes es la mejor decisión para nosotros.




Confianza: Confías en tus compañeros Cubbeños, reconociendo que el trabajo en equipo es esencial para nuestro éxito colectivo.




Empoderamiento: En CUBBO, esperar instrucciones no es opción. Eres un catalizador que empodera a otros a tomar la iniciativa y tomar decisiones de impacto.

About the job

About Rubix Agency

Rubix is a performance marketing agency built for the next chapter of consumer growth. We partner with ambitious consumer brands to drive profitable, measurable growth through paid media, performance creative, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, and analytics. Our clients include brands such as FreshDirect, Fishwife, PetMeds, Mountain House, and Kosterina. What makes Rubix different is our belief that great marketing starts with understanding the economics of a business—not just platform metrics. We help clients make better decisions by connecting marketing performance to customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), contribution margin, incrementality, and long-term growth. We're also building an AI-first operating model. We believe AI should make great marketers more strategic, more consistent, and more efficient—not replace judgment, creativity, or strong client relationships. Our team actively incorporates AI into research, reporting, analysis, creative workflows, quality assurance, and internal operations to deliver better outcomes for clients. Rubix is a remote-first company headquartered in New York and is growing rapidly while maintaining a high bar for talent, ownership, and client partnership. We hire people who enjoy solving difficult business problems, thinking strategically, and building systems that scale.

About The Role

As a Business Manager, you will serve as the operational backbone. In this position, you will bridge the gap between business, marketing, and engineering to streamline processes, drive efficiency, and integrate AI into daily operations.

Own cross-functional operational projects across the agency.

skills: Upon receiving of the customer schedules (via EDI, webEDI or paper), ensure that the Customer requirements are integrated into the system and any integration errors are dealt with and resolved. Loading closed orders onto the system.

If necessary, release picking lists for the Customers’ deliveries.

Follow the complete Supply Chain (procurement, production, and shipping) and chase if necessary, ensure that targeted service levels to the Customer are reached. Monitor the safety stock levels and alert when the min / max levels are reached.
Manage co-operation and logistics issues with logistics external platforms
Ensure that the correct parameters are applied to each reference (MOQ, lead-time, transportation schedule), and if necessary, initiate corrective action plans.
Be aware of/integrated in P1 and P0 projects (new references, new packaging, transfers, new Customers…). Ensure that the returnable packaging loops are adhered to, preventing any packaging shortages.
Prepare the Customs documentation required for exporting if need be.

On a regular basis, communicate complete, precise & reliable information to the Customer contacts. Adapt the chosen method of communication to the level of the Customer contact. Adapt the frequency to the situation (preventative, curative, crisis).
Meet the Customer contacts on a regular basis (once a year for major Customers).
Ensure that the internal scheduling has been launched, taking into account the Customers’ priorities. Make or Ensure the production sequencing based on real customer demand
Measure the daily service rate for each Customer (using the Customers’ calculation and also the internal Customer Service Rate (CSR) calculation). Propose action plans to improve the service level.

Alert sales in the event of a crisis (Customer or internal), to define priorities with the Customer & internally (management, VS for the aftermarket), follow the evolution of any associated action plans. If necessary, escalate through the Logistics Red Alert application.

Make sure that there is a backup for each Customer & train the backup on the way to manage the Customers’ account; ensure that during holidays the position is covered & that both internal & external Customers are notified in advance of the absence and informed of the person that will be temporarily managing the Customers’ account.

title: Líder de CRM y Lifecycle
description:
About the job

Estamos buscando a nuestro próximo Líder de CRM y Lifecycle en Banco Dondé. Este rol no es de "sacar campañas". Es construir el sistema: los journeys automatizados que acompañan al usuario desde que se registra hasta que el banco se vuelve parte de su día a día — activación, hábito, retención y reactivación. Buscamos a alguien que: → Tenga 5+ años en CRM / lifecycle con ownership end-to-end, no solo ejecución → Trabaje con eventos in-app y automatización por comportamiento, no segmentos estáticos → Defienda sus journeys con cohortes y LTV, no con tasas de apertura → No espere un brief para detectar qué funciona y automatizarlo Fintech o banca suma, pero no es requisito: si vienes de una super-app, e-commerce o telecom con lifecycle maduro, queremos platicar contigo. Lo que lo hace distinto: Banco Dondé es parte de Fundación Dondé, que desde hace 106 años apoya la educación de niñas y niños en situación vulnerable. Cada resultado del banco se convierte en oportunidades reales para ellos. CDMX, híbrido, tiempo completo. ¿Te interesa o conoces a alguien ideal? Postúlate

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

Please share your resume in English.

Microsoft Office avanzado.

Lean Management básico.
Gestión de Seguridad Alimentaria.
Análisis y resolución de problemas avanzado.
Conocimientos intermedios en ISO, BRCGS y FDA.

De 3 a 5 años de experiencia en Calidad de Servicio al Cliente.


Educación


Licenciatura o título universitario en Ingeniería (Química, Alimentos o Producción), Ingeniería Química y/o Ingeniería Industrial.


Competencias SIG

Estamos buscando personas que estén dispuestas a lograr resultados de manera constante, incluso en circunstancias difíciles, empleados que creen un clima en el que todos estén motivados para hacer lo mejor que puedan para ayudar a la organización a lograr sus objetivos. Si busca activamente nuevas formas de crecer y ser desafiado, si desarrolla personas para alcanzar tanto sus metas profesionales como las metas de la organización, SIG es el lugar para usted. Para brindar mejores servicios a nuestros clientes, nuestros futuros colegas construyen relaciones sólidas con los clientes y brindan soluciones centradas en el cliente. Finalmente, estamos buscando colegas que construyan asociaciones y trabajen en colaboración con otros para alcanzar objetivos compartidos. ¿Es usted alguien que aplica el conocimiento de los negocios y el mercado para avanzar en los objetivos de la organización? ¿Es usted alguien que puede crear nuevas y mejores formas para que la organización tenga éxito? Si la respuesta es "sí", ven y únase a nosotros.

Nuestra promesa

SIG es el lugar para que construyas algo increíble. Ofrecemos una compensación competitiva y la oportunidad de trabajar parcialmente desde casa. Si se une a nosotros, será parte de una empresa internacional de éxito mundial, que lidera su industria en sostenibilidad, tecnología y más. Nos consideramos la plataforma de lanzamiento profesional: un lugar para desarrollarse rápidamente con trabajo real, experiencia real, oportunidades reales para desarrollar habilidades. Formarás parte de un equipo altamente motivado y dinámico, tendrás oportunidades de desarrollo personal, capacitaciones y oportunidades de entrenamiento de parte de miembros senior del equipo. Si demuestras habilidad y ganas de aprender, te apoyaremos en todo momento.

Acera de SIG

SIG es un proveedor líder de sistemas y soluciones de envasado for better. Trabajamos en colaboración con nuestros clientes para llevar productos alimenticios a los consumidores de todo el mundo de forma segura, sostenible y asequible. Somos el único proveedor de sistemas de envasado que cubre envases de cartón, pouch y bag-in-box. Nuestra tecnología versátil y nuestra capacidad de innovación de productos nos permiten brindar mejores servicios a los clientes, a los consumidores y al mundo. La sustentabilidad nos guía, la tecnología nos empodera, pero es la pasión y el impulso de nuestra gente lo que realmente nos permite brindar mejores resultados. Fundada en 1853, SIG tiene su sede en Neuhausen, Suiza, y cotiza en SIX Swiss Exchange.

About the job

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote opportunities with leading US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.

About the client

Our client is a real estate relocation business based in Boise, Idaho, helping people move to and settle in the Idaho area. They are seeing a steady increase in inbound leads and are building out their front-line sales capacity for the first time.

Overview

We are looking for a Client Care Representative to be the first dedicated salesperson on this team. This person will own the front end of the pipeline: answering and qualifying inbound leads, getting them booked on calls as fast as possible, and keeping the CRM clean and up to date. This is a high-ownership role — the person will work closely with the founders but will manage their own day-to-day without close oversight, so independence and initiative matter as much as sales skill.

Responsibilities

Answer and qualify inbound leads via call, text, and email, prioritizing speed to lead — calling immediately when a phone number is available.
Follow up on incomplete form submissions and email inquiries to re-engage leads and gather missing information.
Schedule appointments, send confirmations and reminders, and follow up on no-shows.
Maintain CRM hygiene in GoHighLevel: cleaning up tags and categories, deduplicating records, and keeping pipeline data accurate.
Cross-check the agent-referral follow-up process (once automation is in place) to catch anything the automation misses.
Keep CRM documentation current so records stay consistent for the team.
Work independently day to day, flagging issues or gaps in the process proactively.

Must-have skills

2-3 years of experience in cold calling, lead intake, or a similar front-line sales role.
Excellent, near-native English, able to build real rapport with US clients on live calls.
Hands-on CRM experience (GoHighLevel a plus, not required — experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM is welcome).
Detail-oriented and comfortable with data hygiene and documentation.
Strong ownership mentality, comfortable managing your own workload with minimal supervision.

Direct experience with GoHighLevel.
Experience using AI tools in daily workflows.
Background in real estate or a relocation-related business.

Comfortable and confident on cold calls.

Work remotely from anywhere in Latin America.

Paid time off and public holidays.

title: Analyst, P2P Customer Care
description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.




Your New Role

This position exists to support the Procure to Pay (PTP) workstream of Warner Bros. Discovery WBD. This person will have overall responsibility for performing PTP functions involved in maintaining PTP processes, ensuring Sox compliance, maintaining a robust controls environment providing updates/reporting of overall Procure to Pay Operations.

Your Role Accountabilities
• Deliver world class / proactive customer service to internal and external stakeholders while adhering to company policies and procedures
• Support PTP processes to ensure operational success (i.e. vendor creation is timely, invoices match to PO’s correctly, invoices route to the appropriate coders, etc.)
• Review PCard statement submissions for compliance
• Monitor and reconcile aging PTP activity, including interfacing applications
• Support integration and onboarding of new acquisitions into Warner Bros. Discovery processes and systems
• Support PTP system changes, improvements and new company codes created with testing as required and support new business projects, acquisitions and integrations where needed
• Serve as a subject matter expert in PTP processes & technologies (SAP SRM, Ariba, PeopleSoft, Oracle, OpenText VIM, SAP ECC) for non-content spend.

Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance or related field is preferred
• Experience in Peoplesoft Financials and SAP is preferred
• Experience in the Media Industry and/or Media Sales is preferred
• A working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint)
• Should have a complete understanding of the PTP process
• Strong listening, verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work independently, creatively and efficiently
• Proven track record in meeting deadlines

The Nice to Haves
• Exclusive Warner Bros. Discovery events and advance screenings
• Paid time off every year to volunteer for eligible employees
• Access to well-being tools, resources, and freebies
• Access to in-house learning and development resources
• Part of the Warner Bros. Discovery family of powerhouse brands




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. description:
About the job

About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

The Nigeria program, established in 2018, is headquartered in Minna, Niger state. We're currently serving over 100,000 unique farmers across the state via our inputs on credit 'Core' program, inputs on cash 'Retail' program, and have a free tree seedling distribution 'Agroforestry' program. To learn more about our work, look at our Nigeria program blog.

About The Role

This role ensures OAF Nigeria's expansion and business innovation agenda delivers on its 2030 ambition by identifying and validating new geographies and revenue opportunities, leading the end-to-end entry of new states from scouting through to operational handover, and building the commercial models that make each new market financially sustainable from day one.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Innovation


You will design OAF Nigeria's 5-year expansion and business innovation strategy, identifying new geographies, new revenue streams, and new commercial models that reduce dependence on any single income line and support the path to financial sustainability.
You will drive from strategy to a concrete annual plan — translating the long-term ambition into sequenced state entries, product and service trials, and business model validations with clear timelines and owners.


Expansion Execution


You will lead the end-to-end entry of new states — from security risk assessment and field scouting through site setup, stakeholder engagement, first-season farmer enrollment, and handover to the Regional Lead.
You will manage the expansion operations calendar, aligning scouting, SRA, state confirmation, infrastructure setup, and planting season windows so that no gate is missed and no entry is made without validated evidence.


People Management and Coaching


You will manage a team of four permanent staff, ensuring each person has clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path.
You will be a senior leader within the Programs Division, providing cross-departmental support through coaching and mentoring of mid-level staff, and helping to build the next generation of State Operations Leads and Regional Leads from within the expansion team.


Monitoring and Reporting


You will develop and track KPIs across all active expansion states and business innovation trials — including farmer enrollment rates, first-season repayment performance, gross margin per farmer, revenue per trial state, and new product uptake against target.
You will produce timely, actionable reports and communicate risks, progress, and go/no-go recommendations to the Head of Programs, Country Director, and Steerco — with the clarity and data quality expected of someone operating at the interface between field execution and organisational strategy.


Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

We seek a professional with over 7 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years leading cross-functional teams and working across multiple departments, combined with a passion for building commercially sustainable agricultural programmes that serve smallholder farmers.


Strategic thinking: Ability to translate a long-term ambition into a sequenced, evidence-based growth plan
Commercial acumen: Experience identifying, designing, and validating new revenue opportunities — products, services, or business models — in complex or resource-constrained environments
Project management: Ability to design, plan, and run multiple complex projects simultaneously to successful outcomes
Growth mindset: Enthusiasm for learning, feedback, and continuous improvement in the face of ambiguity
Results-oriented: You set goals, take ownership, and hold yourself and your team accountable for delivering them
Cross-functional fluency: You collaborate effectively with colleagues across programmes, finance, operations, and external partners
Strong educational background; minimum Bachelor's Degree, postgraduate qualification preferred
Willingness to be based in Minna, Niger State, with significant field travel across expansion states for periods of up to 18 months per assignment
English required; Hausa speaking strongly preferred


Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Minna, Niger State, Nigeria - Onsite

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Nigeria

Application Deadline

16th October, 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

description:
About the job

This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

Our client is an early-stage direct-to-consumer (DTC) company preparing to launch a new physical product designed for online sales. With brand development and packaging nearly complete, the company is entering a critical pre-launch stage focused on building awareness, establishing its digital presence, and generating early market traction.

The founding team brings strong business experience and is seeking its first dedicated marketing hire to translate the brand vision into a scalable go-to-market strategy. Social media and digital channels will serve as primary growth drivers, with a strong emphasis on storytelling, short-form content, brand awareness, and performance-driven execution.

Role Overview

The DTC Marketing Specialist will be responsible for developing and executing the company’s early-stage marketing strategy ahead of product launch. This role will own go-to-market planning, brand awareness initiatives, social-first content strategy, early paid media efforts, performance analysis, and foundational marketing processes.

As the company’s first dedicated marketing hire, the DTC Marketing Specialist will work directly with the founders and balance strategic planning with hands-on execution. The ideal candidate has experience launching or scaling consumer or DTC brands, understands how to build traction through social and digital channels, and is comfortable independently taking marketing initiatives from concept through execution and optimization.

Location

Fully Remote | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST

Key Responsibilities

Go-to-Market Strategy & Launch


Develop and execute a comprehensive go-to-market marketing strategy ahead of product launch.
Translate business and brand objectives into actionable marketing priorities and initiatives.
Establish a clear pre-launch and post-launch marketing roadmap.
Define measurable marketing KPIs to evaluate awareness, engagement, acquisition, and conversion.
Identify and test potential growth opportunities to determine which channels and strategies can scale after launch.


Social Media & Short-Form Content


Develop and oversee a social-first content strategy across Meta, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and similar platforms.

Develop content ideas and storytelling approaches that communicate the brand and product effectively.
Manage content calendars and ensure marketing activities remain organized and aligned with launch priorities.
Coordinate creative production required to support social media and broader marketing initiatives.
Identify emerging social media trends and relevant opportunities for the brand.

Build early brand awareness through consistent positioning, messaging, and storytelling.
Translate the founders’ vision into marketing initiatives that resonate with target consumers.
Ensure marketing communications maintain a cohesive brand identity across digital channels.
Develop initiatives designed to establish a recognizable market presence ahead of launch.
Continuously refine messaging based on audience response and performance insights.

Launch and manage early paid media campaigns when appropriate.
Develop initial campaign tests across relevant acquisition channels.
Test audiences, messaging, creative concepts, and other campaign variables.
Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
Use early results to determine which acquisition approaches have the strongest potential to scale.
Balance paid acquisition initiatives with organic brand-building efforts.


Analytics & Performance Optimization


Track marketing performance across social media, content, paid media, and other digital initiatives.
Establish reporting structures and measurable KPIs for marketing activities.
Analyze campaign and audience data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Translate performance data into actionable recommendations.
Continuously test and iterate marketing initiatives based on results.


Founder Collaboration & Marketing Operations
